relevance.rationale: The 1913 Proc. Amer. Acad. paper that poses and solves the generalized Riemann problem -- characterizing a function by monodromy-type constants independent of its defining equation -- for linear differential equations and, in the allied cases, for linear DIFFERENCE and q-DIFFERENCE equations. This is the origin of the Birkhoff connection matrix, and the corpus is standing on it: QOU/QBeta/BirkhoffAmplitudeWellPosed.lean and BirkhoffAmplitudeE.lean pin the A=3 anti-self-adjoint amplitude E to the GLOBAL 0-to-infinity Birkhoff connection matrix P = (X^infty)^{-1} X^0 of the C1 carrier, and the q-Borel attack plan's stage S3 names the 'Birkhoff-Guenther normal-form extraction' and the 'q-analog of Birkhoff-Malgrange-Sibuya'. All of these cite only the modern RSZ Asterisque; the primary source is unregistered. Explicitly NOT aid-proof: Birkhoff's q-difference theory is the REGULAR (connection-matrix) setting, and the corpus's live obstruction, per the 2026-08-08 closure audit, is an IRREGULAR pure-isoclinic point (slope 1/2, k = 1) where no connection-matrix classification applies. It grounds the vocabulary and the global object; it does not supply the missing Stokes data.

keyResults.locator: the q-difference sections of the 1913 memoir (the 'allied problems')
keyResults.statement: For a linear q-difference system, the analytic solution is characterized by connection constants relating canonical solutions at 0 and at infinity -- the Birkhoff connection matrix -- and the associated Riemann problem asks for those constants to be prescribed at will.
keyResults.useForFolio: The primary source for the global object BirkhoffAmplitudeWellPosed.lean reasons about (P = (X^infty)^{-1} X^0 and the gauge freedom of the canonical local solutions), which currently cites only the modern RSZ treatment.

proposedActions.rationale: Two Lean files are named after the Birkhoff connection matrix and one attack-plan stage after the Birkhoff-Guenther normal form, with no Birkhoff entry in the bibliography.

Record the scope boundary explicitly so the primary source is not over-read: the connection-matrix formulation is the regular-singular q-difference setting, whereas C1's obstruction at infinity is irregular and pure isoclinic. Adding the reference must not be taken to reopen the RSZ route the 2026-08-08 audit closed.
